verdict.rationale: Phaser's core product is an MIT-licensed open-source game framework. It is installed via npm and its source is published on GitHub, so it can be bundled and served entirely from your own infrastructure; the jsDelivr CDN is optional. The pricing page also states that games built with it are not tied to any licence. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of self-hosted deployment, a self-hostable version of the AI-native layer (the Game Agent and its MCP server are hosted by Phaser Studio and no MCP package exists on npm), and independent corroboration of fully offline or self-hosted use.
